description: This file is a configuration source file for a STM32F4 development board using ChibiOS. It initializes hardware peripherals such as GPIO ports, provides early initialization routines, and includes placeholders for SD card and MMC configurations.

methods.name: __early_init
methods.description: Performs early hardware initialization such as clock setup before other system initialization routines.

methods.name: sdc_lld_is_card_inserted
methods.description: Stub function to check if SD card is inserted; currently always returns true.

methods.name: sdc_lld_is_write_protected
methods.description: Stub function to check SD card write protection; currently always returns false.

methods.name: mcc_lld_is_card_inserted
methods.description: Stub function to check if MMC card is inserted; currently always returns true.

methods.name: mmc_lld_is_write_protected
methods.description: Stub function to check MMC write protection; currently always returns false.

methods.name: setSdCardConfigurationOverrides
methods.description: Placeholder for overriding SD card configurations.
